The Gordon tartan is the regimental tartan of the famed Gordon Highlanders, and is based on the iconic Black Watch military tartan. The sett was selected by Alexander Gordon, 4th Duke of Gordon, from three samples submitted by weaver and outfitter William Forsyth. The Heather Grey Selvedge is a 13.5oz Japanese selvedge denim woven using what Japanese mills refer to as top-dyed yarns. Rather than dyeing finished yarns a single flat color, grey cotton fibers in different tones are blended together at the fiber stage before spinning. This mixing of light and dark grey fibers is what creates the fabric’s heathered appearance, similar to classic mixed-grey sweatshirts.
Because the color is achieved through fiber blending rather than surface dyeing, subtle tonal variations remain visible throughout the yarn and fabric. The result is a naturally layered grey with depth and visual softness, avoiding the flat, uniform look of piece-dyed or yarn-dyed greys.
Initially rigid, the denim is designed to break in gradually with wear. Over time, the fabric softens and molds to the body while retaining its structure and textured character. The end result is a refined grey selvedge denim that balances durability, comfort, and understated visual complexity.

p-ironheart-9551619653898.d:
Our western-style CPO shirt, made from 12oz Japanese Wabash—a fabric with origins rooted in centuries-old workwear. To create this authentic Wabash, we individually rope-dye both the warp and the weft yarns (unlike traditional Wabash denim which would feature a natural or white weft) before weaving them into a twill fabric.
The distinctive pattern is then bleached into the fabric post-weave, creating more contrast between the dots and the base colourway. This means that while the rope-dyed yarns are designed to fade and evolve with beautiful character, the signature Wabash dots remain prominent as the fabric ages.
As a CPO cut, this shirt offers a little more length in the body than our standard western cut, with oversized copper snap fastenings and additional side hand warmer pockets.
